observations: Orange gas cylinder with a protective mesh net.
The brand 'Mx' is visible on the side in photo 0.
The valve is brass-colored and appears to be in good condition.
The cylinder is standing upright in an outdoor market setting.
There is handwritten 'Mx' on the bottom of the cylinder in photo 1.
The photos contain watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI PRESH' and 'TECNO POP 10'.

claims.evidence: The weight is not legible on the cylinder in the photos.

claims.claim: Recently tested and certified, no leak, the valve is new.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The cylinder may be expired or past its re-qualification date.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturing or expiry date stamped on the handle or shroud.

risks.risk: The cylinder may be empty or contain a different gas than LPG.
risks.proof: A photo of the cylinder with a weight stamp or a gas type label.

risks.risk: The valve may be leaking or not sealing properly.
risks.proof: A video showing a leak test using soapy water on the valve threads.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and weight.
Photo of the stamped date on the handle or shroud.
Photo of the weight stamp on the cylinder body.
Video of the valve being tested for leaks.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
